important_instructions: All correspondence with candidates shall be done through email only. Shortlisting is based on information furnished in the application; any discrepancy found at any stage will lead to disqualification. Candidates must produce all relevant original documents at the time of document verification. Selected candidates must execute a Contract of Apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules, 1992. content_sections.heading: NIT Calicut Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only candidates who have obtained the prescribed qualification in regular mode, on or after 01st January 2022, shall be considered eligible. The qualification must be obtained from a University/Institution in India or a State Board recognized by the competent authority. Candidates possessing a Master of Library and Information Science (M.Lib.Sc.) shall be eligible only if they have completed their Bachelor’s Degree on or after 01 January 2022 with a minimum of 60% marks. Candidates who have already created an apprenticeship contract with any Government or private organization/institution under NATS are not eligible for apprenticeship training.

faq.question: Q1. What is NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NIT Calicut has invited online applications for engagement as Apprentice Trainees (Graduate and Diploma) for a period of one year under the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NIT Calicut Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 30 vacancies are available, comprising 19 Graduate Apprentice positions and 11 Technician (Diploma) Apprentice positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NIT Calicut Apprentice Trainees?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for General Administration Graduate Apprentice?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline with 60% marks, successfully completed on or after 01 January 2022 from a recognized University/Institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UR candidates applying for Graduate Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for UR candidates applying for Graduate Apprentice posts is 28 years as on 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly stipend for Graduate Apprentices at NIT Calicut?
faq.answer: Graduate Apprentices receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 15,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for NIT Calicut Apprentice Trainees?
faq.answer: Interested candidates are required to submit their applications online only through the designated Google Form link provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for NIT Calicut Apprentices?
faq.answer: The selection process involves scrutiny of applications, shortlisting of eligible candidates, and subsequent calls for document verification and/or written test and/or interview as decided by NIT Calicut.

faq.question: Q10. Does completion of apprenticeship lead to regular employment at NIT Calicut?
faq.answer: No, the apprenticeship training is purely a one-year training engagement and does not confer any right or claim for regular employment or appointment in NIT Calicut.
